For Video Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export 1080p videos in the cloud by describing your needs—no timeline or export settings required.
- Supports uploading 2-minute MP4s (or shorter) directly from your device for quick social video creation.
- Free AI video editing with 30–60 second processing per clip and a simple download link.
- Handles trimming, transitions, overlays, audio tracks, and more via natural text prompts.
- Completely free token system provided (100 credits, 7-day expiry for anonymous users).
- Exports in mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, and aac formats.
